\caption{Feature taxonomy. S: sensitivity (S protected characteristic, P possible proxy or socially sensitive attribute, N neither). M: mutability (M mutable at low cost, PS over the short or medium term, PL over the long term, P set jointly with the institution, I immutable, N not actionable). V and C: whether the person can verify and correct the value (Y yes, P only through institutional or third party records or at the institution's discretion, N no). R: suitability as a principal reason (H high, M medium, L low). Reg B: Regulation B. Reg C: Regulation C, which implements HMDA. Reg Z: Regulation Z. ECOA: Equal Credit Opportunity Act. FCRA: Fair Credit Reporting Act. FCBA: Fair Credit Billing Act. FHA: Fair Housing Act. FD\&C Act: Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act. FFIEC: Federal Financial Institutions Examination Council.}\label{tab:app-taxonomy}\\
